note: Each register's partition names the raw delivered literal OldSecond; its parallel names Second. applied carries a reviewed `[[errata.field]] field = "column_name"` correction OldSecond -> Second: the parallel binds, Second becomes a state column, and the original keeps its delivered literal. drifted carries the same correction, but OldSecond's data length changed after review: a column correction guards every source field, so it and the parallel through it are stale. uncorrected has no correction, so no delivered literal is Second. applied's parallel pin is read from the reviewed delivery, like every other pin here: the digest covers applied's own originals, not the delivery revision that DRIFTED's change moves (maintainer decision 5), so it still binds.
fails_if: `compile_parallel_representations` matches the parallel's columns against the raw delivered Kolumnnamn instead of the checked effective literal, so applied's Second never binds and its parallel goes stale; or the parallel digest again covers the delivery revision, so applied's pin read from the reviewed delivery goes stale when only DRIFTED changed
